hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f && case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ ! -f "$d/package.json" ] && [ "$d" != "/" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; cd "$d" && npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; *.css|*.scss) npx stylelint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac; }
